import unreal, json
actors = unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.EditorActorSubsystem).get_all_level_actors()
rows = []
for a in actors:
    t = a.get_actor_transform()
    row = {'name': a.get_name(), 'label': a.get_actor_label(), 'class': a.get_class().get_name(), 'location': [t.translation.x, t.translation.y, t.translation.z], 'scale': [t.scale3d.x, t.scale3d.y, t.scale3d.z]}
    comps = a.get_components_by_class(unreal.StaticMeshComponent)
    row['meshes'] = [{'component': c.get_name(), 'mesh': c.static_mesh.get_path_name() if c.static_mesh else None} for c in comps]
    if isinstance(a, unreal.LandscapeProxy):
        row['landscape_components'] = [c.get_name() for c in a.get_components_by_class(unreal.LandscapeComponent)]
        row['bounds'] = str(a.get_actor_bounds(False))
    rows.append(row)
print(json.dumps({'engine_version': unreal.SystemLibrary.get_engine_version(), 'world': unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.UnrealEditorSubsystem).get_editor_world().get_path_name(), 'actors': rows, 'tga_class_available': unreal.load_class(None, '/Script/TGAUnrealPlugin.TGAPluginDeveloperSettings') is not None}, indent=2))
